Author: kaldigo
Name: Aetherform
Punchline: Install the Aetherform body and build collection-specific physics presets.
Description: Use /aetherform to install the body through Penumbra, select a collection, adjust physics, and fit vanilla gear on equip.
Changelog: Cloth Detail applies one subdivision pass to flexible vanilla panels, smooths refit displacement, and checks the final cloth against drawn skin. Includes baked bindings and editable fits.
